about: Coro is a cybersecurity company with a Chicago base, offering a modular security platform for small and midsize businesses that handles endpoint, email, data governance and network protection. Customers are SMBs and managed service providers. It has raised about 255 million dollars in funding. B2B software brand with little consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Coroisaybersecurityn company that defends against...

about: Cresta is a Sunnyvale, California company providing AI for contact centres, giving real-time coaching to agents, conversation insights and automation to sales and service teams. Founded in 2017 out of Stanford AI Lab by Zayd Enam, it counts customers such as Intuit, Verizon and Cox, and was backed by Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, Greylock and Tiger Global. Funding of about 276 million dollars. B2B software with no consumer recognition.

Outrider is a company in Henderson, Colorado developing autonomous yard trucks, which move trailers within distribution centres and logistics yards without drivers, using robotic software and hardware. It sells to large shippers and retailers. Funding of around 253 million dollars is shown, from investors such as NEA and others. B2B logistics technology with no consumer brand profile.
cb_desc: Outrider develops robotic software and systems to..

about: Similarweb is a digital market intelligence company, founded in 2007 in Israel, that analyses web traffic, app usage and competitor data to help marketers, investors and sales teams understand online markets. It is headquartered in New York and Tel Aviv, listed on the NYSE (SMWB) since 2021, and has revenue near 250 million dollars, with more than 5,000 customers. B2B data brand, quite well known among marketers and analysts, little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Similarweb
wiki.what: Provider of website rankings and analytics
wiki.text: Similarweb Ltd. is a global software development and data aggregation company specializing in mobile app and web analytics, web traffic, digital performance, SEO tools and generative engine optimization tools. Founded in Israel, the company has 12 offices worldwide. Similarweb went public on the New York Stock Exchange in May 2021.

about: Tines is a Dublin, Ireland workflow automation platform for security and IT teams, letting them build automated workflows without code and, increasingly, with AI agents. Founded in 2018 by Eoin Hinchy and Thomas Kinsella, who earlier worked in security at DocuSign, it counts customers such as Databricks, Canva and Mars, and raised about 271 million dollars from Addition, Goldman Sachs and Felicis, valued at 1.1 billion dollars in 2022. B2B software brand with strong awareness among security teams.

wiki.title: Tine (structural)
wiki.what: Spike on a tool or utensil
wiki.text: Tines, prongs or teeth are parallel or branching spikes forming parts of a tool or natural object. They are used to spear, hook, move or otherwise act on other objects. They may be made of wood, bone, metal, or similar materials.

about: 360Learning is a collaborative learning platform that lets companies create and share courses through peer-led authoring, with AI features, used for onboarding and upskilling. Founded in Paris in 2013 by Nicolas Hernandez and Guillaume Alexandre, it is now run from New York, has customers such as Spotify, Hyatt and Vodafone, and raised about 245 million dollars from Silver Lake, Highland Europe and Salesforce Ventures. B2B software brand with recognition in HR and learning teams.

Anaconda is an Austin, Texas company behind the Anaconda Distribution of Python and R for data science, with packages, a Navigator tool and enterprise platform for AI development and security. Founded in 2012 by Peter Wang and Travis Oliphant, it claims tens of millions of users and sells to enterprises and government. Funding of about 233 million dollars from Insight Partners, Vitruvian, Mayfield and others, with a 2025 round. B2B developer brand, very familiar to data scientists.

wiki.title: Anaconda
wiki.text: Anacondas or water boas are a group of large boas of the genus Eunectes. They are a semiaquatic group of snakes found in tropical South America. Two to four extant and one extinct species are currently recognized, including one of the largest snakes in the world, E. murinus, the green anaconda.

wiki.title: Anaconda (software company)
wiki.text: Anaconda is an open source data science and artificial intelligence development portal and a distribution platform for the Python programming language. Developed by Anaconda, Inc., an American company founded in 2012, the platform is used to develop and manage data science and AI projects. In 2024, Anaconda Inc. has about 300 employees and 50 million users.

about: 7AI is a Boston-based cybersecurity startup that sells an AI-driven security operations platform using autonomous AI agents to triage and investigate alerts for security teams. Customers are enterprises and security operations centres that want to automate analyst work, paid through software subscriptions. The company emerged from stealth in 2025 with a large seed round and then a Series A, bringing total funding to roughly $200 million. It is an early-stage B2B software company with little public brand awareness. Limited details are confirmed beyond its AI-agent security positioning.
cb_desc: 7Al provides an Al-driven cybersecurity platform that

about: Amplience is a London-based software company offering a composable content management and digital experience platform for retailers and brands, including its dynamic content and media delivery tools, now with generative AI features. Customers are mid-size and large e-commerce and fashion brands who use it to produce and deliver product content across websites and apps; revenue comes from SaaS subscriptions. Founded in 2008 in the UK with offices in the US, it has raised over $200 million, largely from growth investors. B2B technology with little consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Amplience is an Al content company that offers the a...

about: Exodigo is an Israeli-founded, Palo Alto-based technology company that uses non-intrusive sensors and AI to produce 3D images of what lies underground, mapping utilities, pipes and cables before construction or excavation. Customers are utilities, civil engineering and construction firms, transport agencies and developers, paid for per-project subsurface mapping services. Founded in 2019, it has raised roughly $212 million, including a large 2025 round. B2B deep-tech with little consumer brand awareness.
cb_desc: Exodigo provides an Al-based platform for subsurface imag...

about: LegalOn Technologies is a legal technology company offering AI-powered contract review and drafting software that flags risks, suggests edits and tracks deals, used by in-house legal teams and law firms. Founded in Tokyo in 2017 as LegalForce, it has a large user base in Japan and expanded to the US from its San Francisco office. Revenue is from SaaS subscriptions, and it has raised about $200 million in funding including a 2023 round of $50 million. B2B software with limited public brand awareness.

Morse Micro is an Australian semiconductor company based in Sydney that designs Wi-Fi HaLow (802.11ah) chips, giving Wi-Fi long range and very low power for IoT devices such as cameras, sensors, smart-home and industrial equipment. Customers are device makers and module vendors, with revenue from chip sales. Founded in 2016 as a spin-out from the University of Sydney and UNSW, it has raised about $205 million in venture funding, including a 2025 round. B2B with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Morse Micro
wiki.text: Morse Micro is a Sydney-based developer of Wi-Fi HaLow microprocessors; chips that enable high data rates, with long range and low power consumption. Amongst all Wi-Fi HaLow systems on a chip, Morse Micro processors are reported to be the smallest, fastest, longest-range with lowest-power-use.

about: PolyAI is a conversational AI company, founded in Cambridge/London in 2017, that builds voice assistants handling customer service calls for enterprises such as hotels, restaurants, banks and utilities, automating bookings and enquiries in many languages. Revenue comes from platform subscriptions and usage. It raised a $86 million Series D in 2025, bringing total funding to over $200 million, with investors including Georgian and NVentures. B2B software with limited consumer awareness; HQ listed as San Francisco in the input.
cb_desc: PolyAl develops conversational artificial intelligence software...

about: Verint Systems is a customer experience automation software company based in Melville, New York, selling AI-powered contact-centre, workforce engagement, speech analytics and bot tools to large enterprises and governments worldwide. Listed on Nasdaq as VRNT, it generates about $900 million in annual revenue and employs around 3,500 staff. Thoma Bravo agreed to take it private in 2025 in a deal worth about $2 billion. B2B software with little consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Verint Systems
wiki.text: Verint Systems Inc. is a Melville, New York–based technology company that sells products and services for customer experience (CX) automation. The company offers an open platform, applications, and bots that incorporate artificial intelligence (AI), advanced analytics, large language models, and automated workflows to analyze business intelligence from customer interactions in the contact center, back office, branch, web sites, and mobile apps. This information is used by organizations to achieve a variety of business outcomes, such as increasing productivity and service quality without hiring additional workers, lowering costs, improving the

about: Antithesis is a Vienna, Virginia-based software testing startup that uses a deterministic simulation approach to find bugs in distributed systems and AI-written code, letting engineering teams replay and reproduce failures. Founded by former FoundationDB engineers, it raised a $105 million Series A in 2025, bringing funding to about $182 million. Customers are software engineering organisations, paid by subscription. B2B developer tool with little public brand awareness.
cb_desc: Antithesis is a simulation testing company that tests...

wiki.title: Antithesis
wiki.what: Topic in philosophy; something that is the opposite of something else
wiki.text: Antithesis is used in writing or speech either as a proposition that contrasts with or reverses some previously mentioned proposition, or when two opposites are introduced together for contrasting effect.

about: CallMiner is a Waltham, Massachusetts software company that sells conversation intelligence, analysing recorded calls, chats and emails with AI to help contact centres improve service, compliance and sales (its Eureka platform). Customers are large enterprises such as banks, insurers and retailers, paid by subscription. Founded in 2002, it has raised about $197 million, including a growth equity investment from Sound Ventures, Insight Partners and others. B2B tech with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: CallMiner
wiki.text: CallMiner is a Massachusetts-based customer experience (CX) automation software company. Founded in 2002, it is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts with offices in the United Kingdom and Prague.

about: Endor Labs is a Palo Alto application security company that helps software teams detect and fix risks in open-source dependencies, code and AI-generated code, with tools including reachability analysis to cut false alerts. Customers are engineering and security teams at tech and financial enterprises, paid by subscription. Founded in 2021, it raised a $93 million Series B in 2025, taking total funding to roughly $188 million. B2B cybersecurity with limited public brand awareness.

Luminary Cloud is a San Mateo, California physics AI company offering a cloud platform that speeds up engineering simulation for design in aerospace, automotive and manufacturing, using GPUs and machine learning to replace slow traditional computational fluid dynamics. Founded in 2021 by former Google and Nvidia staff, it has raised about $187 million, including a $72 million Series B in 2025. Customers are engineering teams. B2B with no consumer brand awareness.
cb_desc: Luminary is a Physics AI platform for rapid design...

about: PostHog is a San Francisco-based open-source product analytics platform that gives engineers one toolset for analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B testing, surveys and data warehousing. Customers are over 100,000 software teams and startups, charged on usage. Founded in 2020 through Y Combinator by James Hawkins and Tim Glaser, it is known for its radical transparency and humorous branding, and has raised about $182 million. B2B developer brand with strong recognition among tech workers.

Pryon is a Raleigh, North Carolina company that sells enterprise knowledge management and AI search software, letting organisations in defence, healthcare, manufacturing and finance ask questions of their documents and receive sourced answers. Founded in 2017 by Igor Jablokov, formerly of Pittsburgh Pattern Recognition, it has raised about $180 million. Revenue is from enterprise licences. B2B software with little consumer brand awareness.
cb_desc: Pryon is an enterprise knowledge managemen.

about: Semgrep is a San Francisco application security company whose platform scans source code, dependencies and secrets to find vulnerabilities, built on an open-source static analysis engine popular with developers. Customers are software and security teams at technology and financial firms, paid by subscription. Founded in 2017 as r2c, it has raised about $193 million, including a 2025 Series D. B2B developer security brand known among engineers but with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Semgrep
wiki.text: Semgrep, Inc. is a cybersecurity company based in San Francisco. The company develops the Semgrep AppSec Platform, a commercial offering for SAST, SCA, and secrets scanning, and maintains the open-source static code analysis tool semgrep, which supports over 30 programming languages.

about: SEON is a Hungarian-founded fraud-prevention company, now listed with an Austin, Texas headquarters, whose platform assesses digital footprints to detect fraud, scams and money laundering for online businesses. Customers include fintechs, payment firms, iGaming operators and e-commerce companies, paid by subscription. Founded in 2017, it raised a $80 million Series C in 2025, bringing funding to about $188 million. B2B software, with some brand profile in iGaming and fintech.

Virtru is a Washington, D.C. data protection company providing email and file encryption and data-centric security software, including a Data Security Platform based on the Trusted Data Format, which lets organisations control access to shared data. Customers are government agencies, defence contractors, healthcare and finance firms, paid by subscription. Founded in 2012 by Will Ackerly and John Ackerly, it has raised about $190 million. B2B security brand with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Virtru
wiki.text: Virtru is a global data encryption and digital privacy provider founded in 2012. The company is headquartered in Washington, D.C.

about: You.com is a San Francisco AI search company founded in 2020 by Richard Socher and Bryan McCann, offering an AI assistant, search engine and APIs for enterprises and developers, with research and agent tools. It raised $100 million at a $1.5 billion valuation in 2025 and about $195 million in total. Revenue is from subscriptions and enterprise API sales. A tech brand with some consumer awareness though far behind the major search engines.

wiki.title: You.com
wiki.text: You.com is an American artificial intelligence and search engine startup company.

about: Eve is a San Mateo legal tech company that builds an AI-native platform for plaintiff law firms, helping with case intake, document review, drafting and discovery in personal injury and mass tort cases. Founded in 2020, it raised a $103 million Series B in 2025 at a valuation of about $1 billion, taking funding to roughly $164 million. Customers are law firms, paid by subscription. B2B software with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Eve
wiki.what: First woman according to the Abrahamic creation myth
wiki.text: Eve is a figure from the Book of Genesis in the Old Testament. According to the origin story of the Abrahamic religions, she was the first woman to be created by God. Eve is known also as Adam's wife.

about: Framer is an Amsterdam-headquartered website builder and design tool that lets designers create, publish and host professional sites visually, with AI features that generate pages from prompts. Customers range from freelancers and startups to enterprises, paid via subscription. Founded in 2013, it raised $100 million in a 2025 Series D at a $2 billion valuation, bringing funding to roughly $161 million. B2B and prosumer brand with strong recognition among designers.

wiki.title: Framer
wiki.text: A framer is someone who builds or creates frames. In construction work, frames may be built from wood or metal and provide support and shape to a structure. In a related sense, framers may create frames for art works, pictures, or mirrors. The term framer is also used for the authors of a formal text such as a constitution.

about: Reka AI is a Sunnyvale-based AI research and product company building multimodal foundation models (Reka Core, Flash and Edge) that understand text, images, video and audio. It was founded in 2022 by researchers from DeepMind, Google and Meta, and has raised about $170 million, including from Nvidia and Snowflake. Customers are enterprises and developers using its models through APIs. B2B AI developer brand with little consumer awareness.

Ripcord is a Hayward, California company offering AI-powered robotic digitisation, converting paper records and documents into searchable digital data for enterprises, utilities and government organisations. Founded in 2014, it has raised about $174 million in funding and uses robotics that open and scan paper files. Customers are large corporates with paper archives, and revenue is from digitisation services. B2B with little consumer brand awareness.

Safe Security is a Palo Alto cyber risk management company providing a platform that measures and quantifies cyber risk in financial terms for boards and security teams, using AI and its SAFE score. Founded in 2012 by Saket Modi and Rahul Tyagi, it has raised about $169 million, including from Sands Capital and Avataar. Customers are large enterprises and insurers, paid by subscription. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

TigerGraph is a Redwood City, California graph database and analytics company whose platform lets enterprises run deep link analysis on connected data, used for fraud detection, supply chain, customer 360 and AI use cases. Founded in 2012 by Yu Xu, it has raised about $172 million. Customers are banks, healthcare, telecom and retail companies, paid via licences and cloud subscriptions. B2B data software, known among data engineers and with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: TigerGraph
wiki.text: TigerGraph is a private company headquartered in Redwood City, California. It provides graph database and graph analytics software.

about: Xelix is a London-based finance software company that uses AI to automate accounts payable controls, detect duplicate payments and errors, and reconcile supplier statements, for large finance teams. Customers are multinationals, paid by subscription. Founded in 2016, it has raised about $165 million, including investment from Insight Partners and others. B2B finance technology with little consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Xelix utilizes Altechnology to automate and enhance the...

about: LangChain is a San Francisco company behind the open-source LangChain framework, and the LangSmith observability platform and LangGraph agent tools, which developers use to build applications and agents on large language models. Founded in 2022 by Harrison Chase, it raised a Series B of $125 million in 2025 at a $1.25 billion valuation, with total funding around $160 million. Customers are developers and enterprises. Very well-known in the AI developer community.

wiki.title: LangChain
wiki.text: LangChain is a software framework that helps facilitate the integration of large language models (LLMs) into applications. As a language model integration framework, LangChain's use-cases largely overlap with those of language models in general, including document analysis and summarization, chatbots, and code analysis.

about: Alianza is a Utah-based cloud communications company offering a platform that telecom operators use to deliver voice, messaging, video and business phone services to residential and business subscribers under their own brand. Customers are cable and fibre operators, and the company also sells a cloud phone product. Founded in 2008 in Pleasant Grove, it has raised about $157 million. B2B with little consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Alianza’s Cloud Communications Platform...

about: AtScale is a Boston-based analytics company that sells a semantic layer platform that sits between data warehouses and BI tools, giving enterprises a single governed definition of metrics for dashboards and AI. Customers are large organisations such as banks and retailers, paid by software subscription. Founded in 2013, it has raised about $157 million. B2B data software with little consumer brand awareness.

DroneDeploy is a San Francisco company whose cloud platform helps organisations plan drone flights, capture and map aerial imagery and robot data for construction, mining, energy and agriculture, with AI analysis. Founded in 2013, it has raised about $158 million, including backing from Andreessen Horowitz and Softbank-linked investors. Customers are contractors, mines and utilities, paid by subscription. B2B with strong recognition in construction technology and little consumer awareness.

iomart Group is a Glasgow-based cloud services provider offering hosting, managed cloud, cyber security and data centre services to UK businesses and public bodies, from its own data centres, with some brands including Melbourne and Cristie. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange (IOM) and employs several hundred staff. Funding is shown as about 115 million. B2B IT services with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Iomart
wiki.what: Scottish IT and cloud computing company
wiki.text: Iomart Group plc is a United Kingdom-based company that specializes in cloud computing and managed IT services, with its headquarters located in Glasgow, Scotland.

about: Konecta is a Madrid-headquartered business process outsourcing company providing customer experience, contact-centre, back-office, digital and AI-enabled services to clients in telecoms, banking, utilities and retail, with tens of thousands of employees across Europe, Latin America and elsewhere. It is privately owned and went through a financial restructuring in 2024. Funding shown is about 150 million. B2B services with little consumer brand awareness.
cb_desc: Konecta is a BPO company providing customer experienc..

wiki.title: Konecta
wiki.text: Konecta is a Spanish multinational services and technology company based in Madrid.

about: Point Wild is a Boston-based online protection and cybersecurity company that Crunchbase describes as an online protection firm, with about $150 million raised. Its portfolio is understood to include consumer privacy and identity-protection products such as Hotspot Shield, sold by subscription, though the exact brands and ownership were not confirmed. Consumer-facing in part, with moderate brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: Point Wild is an online protection company that....

wiki.title: Point Wild
wiki.text: Point Wild is a point 11 kilometers (6.8 miles) west of Cape Valentine on the North coast of Elephant Island in the South Shetland Islands. It lies 2 kilometres (1.2 miles) east of Saddleback Point, and directly adjacent to the Furness Glacier. Its exact coordinates are 61°05'53.0''S and 54°51'39.3''W.

about: Port is a software platform that describes itself as an open AI software factory, an internal developer portal helping engineering teams standardise and automate cloud infrastructure and software delivery. Founded in 2022 in Israel and listed here at Middletown, Delaware, it has raised $100 million in 2025, with funding of about $160 million. Customers are software firms, paid by subscription. B2B developer tooling with limited consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Port is an open Al software factory platform designed for...

wiki.title: Port
wiki.what: Maritime facility where ships may dock to load and discharge passengers and cargo
wiki.text: A port is a maritime facility comprising one or more wharves or loading areas, where ships load and discharge cargo and passengers. Although usually situated on a sea coast or estuary, ports can also be found far inland, such as Hamburg, Manchester and Duluth; these access the sea via rivers or canals. Because of their roles as ports of entry for immigrants as well as soldiers in wartime, many port cities have experienced dramatic multi-ethnic and multicultural changes throughout their histories.

wiki.title: Port (company)
wiki.text: Port is a software company founded in 2022 by Zohar Einy and Yonatan Boguslavski. It develops a platform for building internal developer portals, which enable software engineering organizations to centralize information about software services, development tools, infrastructure and workflows. The platform provides software catalogs, self-service operations and workflow automation intended to help developers manage software delivery and infrastructure more independently.

about: Prophecy.io is a Palo Alto data engineering software company that offers a visual, AI-assisted platform to build and manage data pipelines on cloud data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake, a data transformation copilot. Founded in 2017, it has raised about $159 million. Customers are enterprise data teams, paid by subscription. B2B software with little consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Prophecy.io provides a data transformation copilot for..

about: BlackWall is a Tallinn, Estonia based cybersecurity company that protects websites, hosting providers and cloud infrastructure from attacks, per Crunchbase. It has raised about $163 million, which seems large and should be verified. Customers are hosting providers and online businesses. B2B security software with little consumer brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: BlackWall protects websites, hosting providers, cloud.

about: Guardio is a Tel Aviv-based cybersecurity company providing AI-powered consumer protection, notably a browser extension and app that blocks scams, phishing and malicious sites and monitors for fraud. Founded in 2018, it has raised about $167 million, including a Series B in 2025. Customers are consumers paying a subscription. Moderate consumer awareness, driven by online advertising and influencer marketing.

Celestia is a modular blockchain network that lets developers launch their own blockchains and rollups while outsourcing data availability to a shared base layer. Its native token TIA trades on crypto exchanges and the network launched its mainnet in late 2023. Customers are crypto developers and protocols; revenue comes from network fees paid in the token. The foundation is registered in Liechtenstein, with a distributed team, and has raised roughly 157 million dollars from venture investors. It is a crypto-native brand with almost no mainstream consumer awareness, although crypto firms have sponsored sport before.
cb_desc: Celestia provides a modular blockchain network to deploy .

wiki.title: Celestia
wiki.text: Celestia is a real-time 3D astronomy software program that was created in 2001 by Chris Laurel. The program allows users to virtually travel through the universe and explore celestial objects that have been catalogued. Celestia also doubles as a planetarium, but the user is not restricted to the Earth's surface, like in other planetarium software such as Stellarium. Celestia can display objects of various scales using OpenGL.

about: Groundcover is a Tel Aviv cloud-native observability company whose platform uses eBPF technology to monitor applications, logs and infrastructure inside Kubernetes environments, with a bring-your-own-cloud pricing model. Customers are engineering and DevOps teams at software and technology companies, paying through subscriptions. It was founded around 2021 and has raised about 160 million dollars in venture funding, including a 2026 round. It is a private B2B developer tool with little public brand awareness outside the software engineering community.
cb_desc: Groundcover develops cloud- native observability software...

wiki.title: Groundcover
wiki.text: Groundcover or ground cover is any plant that grows low over an area of ground, which protects the topsoil from erosion and drought. In a terrestrial ecosystem, the ground cover forms the layer of vegetation below the shrub layer known as the herbaceous layer, and provides habitats and concealments for terrestrial fauna. The most widespread ground covers are grasses of various types.

about: authID is a Denver-based identity authentication company offering biometric face-based verification and passwordless login for enterprises, banks and fintechs, including its Verified and Ceremony products. It earns software subscription and transaction fees. Formerly Ipsidy, it rebranded as authID in 2021 and trades on Nasdaq under AUID. Total funding is about 110 million dollars. It is a small B2B cybersecurity brand with little consumer awareness.

Red Violet is a Boca Raton, Florida data analytics firm offering identity intelligence and risk platforms such as idiCORE and FOREWARN, which help investigators, collections, insurers and real estate professionals locate and verify people and assets. It earns subscription revenue and was spun out from Cogint (formerly Fluent) in 2018. It trades on Nasdaq (RDVT). It is a B2B information provider with little public brand awareness.

wiki.title: Red-violet
wiki.text: Red-violet is a rich color of high medium saturation about 3/4 of the way between red and magenta, closer to magenta than to red. In American English, this color term is sometimes used in color theory as one of the purple colors—a non-spectral color between red and violet that is a deep version of a color on the line of purples on the CIE chromaticity diagram.

about: DOOR is a St. Louis, Missouri technology company that Crunchbase describes as providing integrated hardware and software, tagged under apps and artificial intelligence. The listing shows about $342 million in total funding, with the most recent round dated in 2025, indicating substantial investor backing. The customer type and specific product are not clear from the available data, so it should be treated as an early-stage B2B technology business in the US Midwest. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: DOOR provides integrated hardware and software...

about: Lightricks is a Jerusalem-based software company, founded in 2013, behind consumer creative apps including Facetune, Videoleap, Photoleap and Motionleap, plus LTX Studio and the open-source LTX video model for generative AI video. It earns subscription revenue from hundreds of millions of app downloads and from API and studio products. It has raised over $300 million in funding and is valued above $1 billion. Strong consumer app brand with a global user base, especially among creators and social media users.

wiki.title: Lightricks
wiki.text: Lightricks is a software development company founded in January 2013. The company develops Facetune, a mobile app for image editing, and LTX, a generative text-to-video model. The company is headquartered in Jerusalem, Israel, with approximately 600 employees. The company was valued at $1.8 billion in 2021.

about: CircleCI is a San Francisco-based software company, founded in 2011, that offers a continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) platform used by developers to automatically build, test and deploy code. It sells subscription plans to software teams from startups to large enterprises, in cloud and self-hosted form, and claims a large share of open-source and commercial projects. It has raised around $315 million from investors including Greenspring and Sapphire. B2B developer tool well known among engineers but not to general consumers.

Laiye is a Beijing artificial intelligence and automation company, founded in 2015 and previously known for robotic process automation (RPA) and intelligent document processing, now offering AI agents and enterprise workflow tools. It serves large Chinese enterprises in finance, telecoms and manufacturing, plus some international clients, and earns software licence and subscription fees. It has raised about $200 million from investors including Hillhouse and Sequoia China. B2B software brand with no consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Laiye provides an Al platform to enhance productivity and...

about: BetterCloud is a New York software company, founded in 2011, that offers a SaaS operations platform helping IT teams automate onboarding, offboarding, security and management of employee access across applications such as Google Workspace, Slack and Microsoft 365. Customers are mid-sized and large organisations, paying subscription fees. It has raised about $187 million from investors including Warburg Pincus and Bessemer. B2B IT software brand with limited recognition outside the IT community.

wiki.title: BetterCloud
wiki.text: BetterCloud, an independent software vendor based in New York, NY and with engineering offices in Atlanta, GA, builds unified SaaS management software. A venture-backed startup, BetterCloud has raised $187 million in total funding, with the most recent round was led by Warburg Pincus with series F funding with $75 million raised to date. A previous round of funding was done in April 2018 which was led by Bain Capital Ventures. In December 2016, BetterCloud completed pivot from G Suite to general SaaS management. In March 2026, BetterCloud was acquired by CoreStack.

about: Typeform is a Barcelona software company, founded in 2012, offering a no-code platform for building conversational forms, surveys and quizzes that look more like a chat than a standard form. Customers range from individuals and marketers to large enterprises across many industries, and revenue comes from subscription plans. It has raised about $187 million from investors including Index Ventures and General Atlantic and has millions of users worldwide. Well recognised among marketers and online creators.

Lido is a decentralised liquid staking protocol, with its main product letting users stake Ethereum and other proof-of-stake assets to receive tradable staked tokens such as stETH, while earning staking rewards. Governed by Lido DAO and its LDO token, it holds a large share of all staked ETH, billions of dollars in assets. Contributors are distributed globally and Crunchbase lists a London base. It earns a fee on staking rewards and raised about $167 million. Well known in crypto, not among general consumers.

Syniverse is a Tampa, Florida telecommunications technology company, founded in 1987 (as GTE TSI), providing messaging, roaming, number portability, analytics and network services that connect mobile operators and enterprises. Customers include most of the world's carriers and large businesses, and it is owned by private equity investor Carlyle. It has raised about $780 million. B2B telecom infrastructure company with no consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Syniverse
wiki.text: Syniverse is an American communications technology company with a focus on 5G roaming, communications platform as a service (CPaaS), A2P Messaging, roaming clearing and settlement, IPX, fraud prevention, mobile identify and authentication solutions, IoT, Private Networks and other emerging technologies leveraged by global enterprises and telecommunication carriers.

about: Sysdig is a San Francisco cloud security company, founded in 2013, whose platform secures containers, Kubernetes and cloud workloads through runtime detection, vulnerability management and cloud security posture tools. Customers are large enterprises and technology companies, paying subscription fees. It created the open-source Falco project and has raised about $730 million, reaching a valuation of $2.5 billion. B2B security brand known to developers and security teams, but not to the public.

Blue Yonder, formerly JDA Software, is a Scottsdale, Arizona supply chain software company providing AI-driven planning, demand forecasting, warehouse, transportation and retail planning tools to manufacturers, retailers and logistics companies. It was acquired by Panasonic in 2021 for about $7.1 billion, and itself acquired One Network Enterprises in 2024. It has thousands of customers worldwide and earns subscription and services revenue. B2B software brand, widely known to supply chain professionals, but not to consumers.

Cockroach Labs is a New York company, founded in 2015, that develops CockroachDB, a distributed SQL database designed to survive failures and scale across regions, sold as a managed cloud service and self-hosted software. Customers are enterprises in financial services, retail, gaming and technology, with subscription revenue. It has raised about $633 million and reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2021. B2B database brand known to developers, not consumers.

wiki.title: CockroachDB
wiki.text: CockroachDB is a source-available distributed SQL database management system developed by Cockroach Labs.

about: Illumio is a Sunnyvale, California cybersecurity company, founded in 2013, whose zero-trust segmentation platform prevents breaches from spreading by controlling traffic between workloads, data centers and clouds. Customers are large enterprises, banks, healthcare and government agencies, paying subscription fees. It has raised about $560 million from investors including Andreessen Horowitz and General Catalyst and was valued at $2.75 billion. B2B security brand, known to IT teams, not consumers.

wiki.title: Illumio
wiki.text: Illumio is an American cybersecurity company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, specializing in breach containment. The company’s platform helps prevent lateral movement and strengthen cyber resilience across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

about: Lucid Software is a South Jordan, Utah visual collaboration company, founded in 2010, whose products include the Lucidchart diagramming tool, Lucidspark whiteboard and Lucidscale cloud visualisation. It sells subscriptions to individuals and enterprises, with tens of millions of users and customers including many Fortune 500 companies. It has raised about $670 million and was valued at $3 billion in 2021. Known in business and education, but mostly a B2B software brand.

Orca Security is a cloud security company, founded in 2019 in Israel and now headquartered in Portland, Oregon, whose agentless SideScanning technology scans cloud workloads, configurations and identities for risk across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. It sells subscriptions to enterprises, raised about $630 million, and was valued at $1.8 billion in 2021. B2B cybersecurity brand known to security teams, but not to the general public.

Twilio is a San Francisco cloud communications company, listed on the NYSE (TWLO), founded in 2008, whose APIs let developers build messaging, voice, video and email features into apps. It also owns Segment (customer data) and SendGrid (email), and serves hundreds of thousands of customers, from startups to large enterprises. Revenue is around $4.5 billion, earned on usage-based and subscription fees. Widely known in technology and developer communities, but a B2B brand with little consumer recognition.

wiki.title: Twilio
wiki.text: Twilio Inc. is an American cloud communications company based in San Francisco, California, which provides programmable communication tools for making and receiving phone calls, sending and receiving text messages, and performing other communication functions using its web service APIs. Founded in 2008, the company received multiple rounds of funding prior to its 2016 initial public offering. Twilio has acquired a number of companies since 2015, including the two-factor authentication service Authy and email marketing platform SendGrid. Twilio was subject to three data breaches in 2022 and 2024.

about: Clari is a Sunnyvale, California revenue operations platform, founded in 2012, using AI to forecast sales, track deals and manage pipeline for revenue teams. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as Okta, Workday and Zoom, which pay subscription fees. It has raised about $500 million, including a 2022 round at a $2.6 billion valuation. B2B software brand known to sales leaders, not to consumers.

wiki.title: Clari
wiki.text: Clari is an opera semiseria in three acts by Fromental Halévy, to an Italian libretto by Pietro Giannone. It was first produced at the Théâtre-Italien in Paris on 19 December 1828.

about: Forter is a New York fraud prevention company, founded in 2013 in Israel, whose platform uses machine learning to approve or decline e-commerce transactions in real time and prevent payments, return and account takeover fraud. Customers include online retailers and travel companies such as Instacart, Nordstrom and Priceline, who pay on a transaction basis. It has raised about $525 million and was valued at $3 billion in 2021. B2B security brand known to retailers, not consumers.

wiki.title: Forter
wiki.text: Forter is a software as a service (SaaS) company that unifies identity protection, payments optimization and fraud prevention in a single consumer authentication platform. The company's technology applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to pinpoint the identity behind any digital commerce interaction. This ensures that good consumers can complete their transactions, while fraudsters and serial abusers are blocked. Since the company's founding in 2013, Forter has processed more than $1 trillion in digital commerce transactions and amassed a dataset of more than 1.5 billion online identities.

about: Outreach is a Seattle-based sales engagement platform, founded in 2014, using AI to help sales teams automate emails, calls and meetings, forecast deals and manage pipeline. Customers are sales organisations who pay subscription fees. It has raised about $490 million and was valued at $4.4 billion in 2021. B2B software brand known to sales teams, with no consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Outreach
wiki.what: Provision of services to populations who lack access
wiki.text: Outreach is the activity of providing services to any population that might not otherwise have access to those services. A key component of outreach is that the group providing it is not stationary, but mobile; in other words, it involves meeting someone in need of an outreach service at the location where they are. Compared with traditional service providers, outreach services are provided closer to where people may reside, efforts are very often voluntary, and have fewer, if any, enforceable obligations. In addition to delivering services, outreach has an educational role, raising the awareness of existing services. It includes identificati

about: SingleStore is a San Francisco database company, formerly MemSQL, whose cloud-native database handles transactions and real-time analytics in one engine for AI and data-intensive applications. Customers are enterprises in financial services, media and technology. It raised about $464 million, and in 2025 it was acquired by Vector Capital. Founded in 2011. B2B data infrastructure brand known to developers and data engineers, with no consumer awareness.

wiki.title: SingleStore
wiki.text: SingleStore is a distributed, relational, SQL database management system (RDBMS) that features ANSI SQL support, designed to handle data ingest, transaction processing, and query processing.

about: SonarSource is a Swiss software company, headquartered in Vernier near Geneva, founded in 2008, that makes SonarQube, SonarCloud and SonarLint, which continuously inspect code for bugs, vulnerabilities and quality issues, now positioned as a verification layer for AI-generated code. Customers are software teams from startups to large enterprises, with millions of developers using its tools. It has raised about $457 million, mostly in a 2022 round led by Insight Partners and Permira, and is valued at about $4.7 billion. B2B developer tool known among engineers.

wiki.title: Sonar (company)
wiki.text: Sonar is a Swiss company founded in 2008. It develops open source software and commercial software for continuous code quality and code security.

about: Docker is a software company, based in the San Francisco Bay Area and founded in 2010 as dotCloud, that popularised containers for developers with its open-source Docker Engine and Docker Desktop, Docker Hub image registry, and security and AI developer tools. It serves millions of developers and many companies, which pay subscriptions for team and enterprise features. It has raised about $436 million. B2B developer brand with very strong awareness among software engineers.

eSentire is a Waterloo, Ontario managed cybersecurity company, founded in 2001, offering managed detection and response (MDR), exposure management and incident response services around the clock to mid-sized and large organisations in financial services, healthcare and other sectors. It protects thousands of organisations worldwide and earns recurring service fees. It has raised about $411 million. B2B security services brand with no consumer awareness.

Lookout is a US mobile and cloud security company, headquartered in the Boston area and with offices in San Francisco, whose endpoint-to-cloud platform protects enterprise data from phishing, malware and data leaks. It was founded in 2007 as a consumer mobile security app, and it sold its consumer business to F-Secure in 2023. Customers are enterprises and government agencies. It has raised about $432 million from investors including Accel and Greylock. B2B security brand, now with little consumer visibility.

wiki.title: Lookout
wiki.what: Person on a ship in charge of the observation of the sea for hazards
wiki.text: A lookout or look-out is a person in charge of the observation of hazards. The term originally comes from a naval background, where lookouts would watch for other ships, land, and various dangers. The term has now passed into wider parlance.

about: Denodo Technologies is a Palo Alto, California data management company, founded in 1999 in Spain, whose data virtualisation platform lets organisations access and integrate data from many sources without moving it, supporting analytics and AI. Customers are large enterprises in banking, healthcare, manufacturing and government, with subscription revenue. It has raised about $336 million. B2B software brand known to data teams, not to consumers.

Miovision is a Kitchener, Ontario traffic technology company, founded in 2005, that makes traffic signal controllers, AI-driven traffic data collection and adaptive signal optimisation for cities, public agencies and consultants worldwide. Its Surtrac and TrafficLink platforms help reduce congestion and collect data at intersections. It has raised about $358 million. Government and municipality customers. B2B smart city brand with no consumer awareness.

Data intelligence software company in Redwood City, California, founded in 2012, best known for its data catalog and governance platform used to find, understand and trust enterprise data and AI inputs. Customers are large enterprises, many in finance and retail, buying subscription software. Venture-funded, with a roughly $300 million-plus funding total. B2B software brand known to data teams, not consumers.

wiki.title: Alation
wiki.text: Alation is an enterprise software company based in Silicon Valley.

about: Alpheya is a software company based in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, that delivers cloud-native, AI-enabled technology, apparently for wealth and asset management. Crunchbase shows funding of $300 million. It likely sells platform software to banks and wealth managers in the Gulf region. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: Alpheya is a software company that delivers cloud-native, Al-..

about: Cybersecurity company headquartered in New York with major operations in Israel, specializing in behavioral biometrics that detect fraud and account takeover by analyzing how users type, swipe and move. Sold to banks and financial institutions worldwide. Acquired by private equity firm Permira in 2024 in a deal valued at about $1.3 billion. B2B brand known in banking security, with no consumer awareness.

Cybersecurity company in New York, founded in Israel in 2015, applying deep learning neural networks to prevent malware and ransomware on endpoints, servers, storage and mobile. Sells to enterprises and governments globally via subscriptions and channel partners. Venture-funded with around $320 million raised. B2B security brand, known to IT buyers rather than consumers.

wiki.title: Deep Instinct
wiki.text: Deep Instinct is a cybersecurity company that applies deep learning to cybersecurity. The company implements artificial intelligence to the task of preventing and detecting malware. The company was the recipient of the Technology Pioneer by The World Economic Forum in 2017.

about: San Jose-based networking company founded in 2021 by former Cisco executives, selling campus and branch networks as a managed service with AI-driven operations, with a performance guarantee. Customers are mid-size and large enterprises, education and healthcare, paying subscription fees. Venture-funded, with about $300 million raised. B2B network infrastructure brand, known mainly to IT buyers.

wiki.title: Nile
wiki.text: The Nile is a major north-flowing river in northeast Africa which empties into the Mediterranean Sea. At 7,088 kilometers (4,404 mi) long, it is the longest river in the world, although the volume of water it carries is much smaller than other major rivers such as the Amazon or the Congo. The Nile has played a central role in the environmental, economic, and cultural history of Africa for millennia.

wiki.title: Nile (company)
wiki.text: Nile is a multinational technology company that delivers network and security infrastructure services for enterprises and government organizations. The company is based in San Jose, California, and operates primarily in North America, with a presence in twenty-five countries across Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.

about: IoT connectivity company based in Hopkins, Minnesota, listed on Nasdaq (DGII), selling cellular routers, embedded modules, development tools (XBee, Digi Remote Manager) and software to enterprises, utilities and OEMs. Revenue is hardware and recurring cloud services, around 400 million dollars a year. Founded in 1985. B2B technology brand, known within industrial and embedded markets.

wiki.title: Digi International
wiki.text: Digi International, Inc. is an American industrial Internet of things technology company based in Hopkins, Minnesota. Founded in 1985, it was best known in the early 1990s as a manufacturer of multi-line serial data serial cards for PC clones, allowing these machines to run multi-line bulletin board systems (BBSes). As this market began to wind down with the rise of the internet in the late 1990s, Digi began to concentrate on network attached devices and industrial monitoring.

about: Chicago-based supply chain visibility software company providing real-time tracking and AI-driven predictions for shipments across road, rail, ocean and air, used by large shippers, retailers and carriers. Subscription revenue. Founded in 2014, venture-funded to a valuation above $1 billion. B2B technology brand, with industry awareness but no consumer profile.

Mountain View-based AI company whose open-source H2O platform and Driverless AI/H2O AI Cloud help enterprises build predictive and generative AI models. Customers include banks, insurers, health companies and governments. Founded in 2012, venture-funded with about $250 million raised. B2B AI brand well known among data scientists.

Boston-based data security and access governance platform that lets enterprises find, secure and control sensitive data across cloud data platforms. Customers are large banks, government agencies and health organizations paying subscriptions. Founded in 2015, venture-funded with about $258 million. B2B security brand known to data and security teams.

wiki.title: Immuta
wiki.text: Immuta Inc. is an American data security platform and software company. The company provides a cloud-native data governance platform to businesses, governmental agencies, and healthcare organizations.

about: Mountain View-based NoSQL database company providing real-time, high-performance databases used for ad tech, fraud detection and payments. Customers are large enterprises, telecoms and banks. Founded in 2009, with investors including Sumeru. B2B software brand, known by developers.
cb_desc: Aerospike is a NoSQL database designed for real-time and...

wiki.title: Aerospike (company)
wiki.what: Technology company based in Mountain View, California, US
wiki.text: Aerospike is the company behind the Aerospike NoSQL distributed database management system. Citrusleaf, a Mountain View, California based company which rebranded to Aerospike in August 2012, announced the product in 2011. The software is used by developers to deploy real-time big data applications.

about: London-based talent lifecycle management platform using AI for recruiting, internal mobility and workforce planning for large employers. Founded in 2013, venture-funded with about $223 million. B2B HR software brand, known to HR departments.
cb_desc: Beamery provides an Al-based talent lifecycle managemen...

wiki.title: Beamery
wiki.text: Beamery is a British human resources software company headquartered in London. It develops an artificial intelligence-based platform for recruitment, talent management, workforce planning, and employee development. The company was founded in 2013 by brothers Abakar and Sultan Saidov and Michael Paterson. Has Dosanjh is its chief executive officer.

about: Boston-based enterprise file data company providing a cloud-native file services platform to store, protect and share unstructured data, replacing traditional network-attached storage. Customers are large enterprises in manufacturing, media and healthcare buying subscriptions. Founded in 2008 and venture-funded, with about $247 million raised. B2B technology brand, known to IT buyers.
cb_desc: Nasunis acloud storagehid company that provides hybrid...

wiki.title: Nasuni
wiki.text: Nasuni Corporation is a privately held hybrid cloud storage company with headquarters in Boston, Massachusetts.

about: Washington DC-based AI company that improves customer contact center outcomes by pairing callers with the best-matched agents using machine learning. Customers are large telecoms, banks and retailers, paid on performance. Founded by Zia Chishti. B2B brand.
cb_desc: Afiniti leverages artificial intelligence to improve...

wiki.title: Afiniti
wiki.text: Afiniti is a multinational company specializing in artificial intelligence applications for customer experience optimization in contact centers, founded in 2005. The company develops technologies that use machine learning to match customers with call center agents, with applications in sectors including telecommunications, financial services, healthcare, and insurance.

about: San Francisco-based active metadata and data collaboration platform helping data teams catalog, govern and understand data assets, serving customers such as enterprises and tech firms. Founded in 2020 in India and venture-funded with about $200 million raised. Founders Prukalpa Sankar and Varun Banka lead it. B2B software brand, known in data engineering.
cb_desc: Atlan is an active metadata platform crafted for data team...

about: San Francisco-based customer service software company offering a platform that gives agents a unified view of each customer, now with AI assistance, used by retailers and consumer brands. Founded in 2014 and venture-funded with about $208 million. B2B software brand, known to customer-service teams.
cb_desc: Customer Experience Al Platform

wiki.title: Gladly
wiki.text: "Gladly" is a song by British musician Tirzah. It was produced by Mica Levi. The single was released on 3 March 2018.

about: Austin-based cybercrime analytics and identity threat protection company, which collects recovered breach data to alert organizations to stolen credentials. Customers are large enterprises and government. Founded in 2016 and venture-funded with about $203 million. B2B security brand.
cb_desc: SpyCloud is the leader in Cybercrime Analytics. Thei...

about: Tel Aviv-based cybersecurity company offering a security analytics platform for hybrid environments; funding shown is $185 million. B2B brand known in cyber circles.
cb_desc: Vega Security offers f cybersecurity services for...

wiki.title: Vega
wiki.what: Brightest star in the constellation Lyra
wiki.text: Vega is the brightest star in the northern constellation of Lyra. It has the Bayer designation α Lyrae, which is Latinised to Alpha Lyrae and abbreviated Alpha Lyr or α Lyr. This star is relatively close to the Solar System, at only 25 light-years from the Sun, and one of the most luminous stars in the Sun's neighborhood, being intrinsically brighter than any star nearer to the Sun. It is the fifth-brightest star in the night sky, and the second-brightest star in the northern celestial hemisphere, after Arcturus.

wiki.title: Vega (company)
wiki.text: Vega is a brand of plant based nutritional products. The company was started in Burnaby by Charles Chang and Brendan Brazier in 2004. In 2015, Vega was sold to Denver-based giant Whitewave Foods for US$550 million.

about: Seattle-based network detection and response company, whose Reveal(x) platform analyzes network traffic for cyber threats. Founded in 2007 by Jesse Rothstein and Raja Mukerji, it sells subscriptions to security teams that want visibility into encrypted and cloud traffic. Acquired in 2021 by Bain Capital Private Equity and Crosspoint Capital for about $900 million. Customers are large enterprises and governments. B2B security brand.

wiki.title: ExtraHop Networks
wiki.text: ExtraHop is a Seattle-based cybersecurity company providing AI-based network intelligence.

about: Portsmouth, New Hampshire-based fiber network provider (FirstLight Fiber) delivering internet, data center and cloud connectivity to businesses, governments and carriers in the northeastern United States. Owned by infrastructure investors. Funding shown is about $165 million. B2B telecom brand.
